lines.1: 「The executive committee has tomorrow off. If you come, the building will be closed, so consider yourselves warned. --End of announcement.」
lines.2: 「Now, there was some commotion at lunch. Date, what did they call you in for?」
lines.3: 「Oh, it was the track team from Yuihama Academy. They wanted me to transfer there.」
lines.4: 「They were scouting you! Amazing, right? Yuihama Academy in Shonan is super famous for track and field.」
lines.5: 「Damn Crab was eavesdropping. What a hopeless little runt.」
lines.6: 「Wow, that's incredible! They invited you to join them?」
lines.7: 「That's a wonderful offer. So you accepted?」
lines.8: 「Nope, I turned them down. Their training is brutal. It doesn't fit my motto: have fun and take it easy.」
lines.10: 「That so? Then I guess staying was worth it.」
lines.25: 「...What is this conversation beyond human comprehension? It's kind of gross.」
